Prevention: Rectification of soil pH by adding gypsum.
NAA (Planofix) mixed in 1 litre of water on the inflorescence.
Soil mulching with green fronds reduces evapotranspiration and conserves soil moisture.
Ensuring sufficient irrigation during summer and drainage during winter will lead to a sustainable yield.
Monitoring: Look for shedding of buttons and premature nuts.
Excess acidity or alkalinity in soil.
Observe for presence of insect pests/diseases
Direct Control: Kg of farm yard manure per palm with borax 150 gram per tree.
Root feeding of coconut tonic at 40 ml in 160 ml of water per palm once in 6 months will control the button shedding and enhance the yield.
Restrictions: No separate chemical management is available.
